premise: Autumn leaves come twirling down and Hedgehog gathers them for his winter bed, but the wind keeps blowing his pile away; Squirrel and Badger help him, and he curls up snug.
inspiration: The Little Red Hen (folk), where nobody helps; turned: this time everyone helps, and the one who works alone gets a bed made by three.
lesson: Hard jobs are easier with friends.
learning: Hedgehogs gather dry leaves to make a cosy nest for their winter sleep.

en-US.title: Hedgehog Makes a Leaf Bed
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 50s} [softly] It was autumn, and red and gold leaves came twirling down. {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog was busy. {hedgehog:face happy} One leaf, two leaves, three leaves… a pile for his winter bed. {canvas:wind 0.8 14s} {sfx:gust} WHOOSH! Off flew the leaves. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} [gasps] Oh! Hedgehog started again. One leaf, two leaves… WHOOSH! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Every leaf, gone. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to hedgehog} Squirrel came bounding up. {squirrel:face surprised} What's wrong? {badger:enter} {badger:go to hedgehog} Badger trotted over too. {hedgehog:shake} My bed keeps blowing away, sighed Hedgehog. Badger scratched his head. Then he {badger:live} dug a little hollow, just right. {squirrel:live} Squirrel hid her hazelnut, just to be safe. Armful after armful, they filled the hollow with dry, crackly leaves. {sfx:crunch} Crunch, crunch. No wind could reach them there. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} Hedgehog snuggled in, {hedgehog:live hold} and curled up into a warm, prickly ball. [whispers] Goodnight, Hedgehog, whispered Squirrel. {badger:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} {badger:hearts} See you in the spring.

es-ES.title: La cama de hojas de Erizo
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6 50s} [softly] Era otoño, y caían hojas rojas y doradas, dando vueltas. {hedgehog:enter} Erizo estaba muy ocupado. {hedgehog:face happy} Una hoja, dos hojas, tres hojas… un montón para su cama de invierno. {canvas:wind 0.8 14s} {sfx:gust} ¡FIUUU! Las hojas salieron volando. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:spin} [gasps] ¡Oh! Erizo empezó otra vez. Una hoja, dos hojas… ¡FIUUU! {hedgehog:face sad} [sad] Ni una hoja. {squirrel:enter} {squirrel:go to hedgehog} Ardilla llegó dando saltos. {squirrel:face surprised} ¿Qué te pasa? {badger:enter} {badger:go to hedgehog} Tejón se acercó trotando. {hedgehog:shake} Mi cama sale volando, suspiró Erizo. Tejón se rascó la cabeza. Y entonces {badger:live} cavó un hoyito, justo a su medida. {squirrel:live} Ardilla escondió su avellana, por si acaso. Brazada a brazada, llenaron el hoyo de hojas secas y crujientes. {sfx:crunch} Cruj, cruj. Allí no llegaba ningún soplo. {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:hearts} Erizo se acurrucó dentro {hedgehog:live hold} y se hizo una bola calentita de pinchos. [whispers] Buenas noches, Erizo, susurró Ardilla. {badger:face happy} {squirrel:face happy} {badger:hearts} Hasta la primavera.
